records.source: The little family is gathered around the dinner table. Wait... except Grandpa. He's wedged under the bed for some reason.
records.translation: Nagkakatipon ang munting pamilya sa hapag-kainan. Sandali... maliban kay Lolo. Nakasiksik siya sa ilalim ng kama sa kung anong dahilan.

records.source: You rummage through Marnie's dresser. It's mostly long dresses, but there's a pair of brown suspenders in here as well.
records.translation: Hinalungkat mo ang tokador ni Marnie. Karamihan ay mahahabang damit, pero may isang pares din ng kayumangging suspender dito.

records.source: You dig around in Marnie's private drawer. There's nothing of interest.
records.translation: Hinalungkat mo ang pribadong drawer ni Marnie. Walang kawili-wili rito.

records.source: Looks like he's using the radio as an alarm clock.
records.translation: Mukhang ginagamit niya ang radyo bilang orasan pang-alarma.

records.source: Jack-in-the-box is sprawled out, his arms bent at grotesque angles. His hollow eyes peer coldly into the distance.
records.translation: Nakahandusay ang laruang tumatalon mula sa kahon, at nakabaluktot ang mga braso nito sa nakapanghihilakbot na anggulo. Malamig na nakatitig sa malayo ang hungkag nitong mga mata.

records.source: It's a Mega Station. There's a game in it, but it's routed through a Code Sultan XL. Looks like someone's been cheating.
records.translation: Isa itong Mega Station. May laro rito, pero nakakonekta ito sa isang Code Sultan XL. Mukhang may nandaraya.

records.source: It's a mess of arts and crafts.
records.translation: Magulo ang mga gamit sa sining at likhang-kamay.

records.source: It doesn't look used. Maybe it's a collector's ball.
records.translation: Mukhang hindi ito nagagamit. Baka bola ito ng kolektor.

records.source: A little paint set.
records.translation: Munting gamit sa pagpipinta.

records.source: There's an antique clock and a little golden trinket box.
records.translation: May antigong orasan at munting gintong kahon ng palamuti.

records.source: Doesn't seem like Jas uses this much.
records.translation: Mukhang hindi ito gaanong ginagamit ni Jas.

records.source: It's locked.
records.translation: Naka-lock ito.

records.source: Mmm.... microwave pizza.
records.translation: Mmm.... pizza mula sa microwave.

records.source: Looks like someone was chopping vegetables but never finished.
records.translation: Mukhang may naghihiwa ng mga gulay pero hindi natapos.

records.source: Why are you looking through my trash can?$s
records.translation: Bakit mo hinahalungkat ang basurahan ko?$s

records.source: Mostly empty pizza cartons.
records.translation: Karamihan ay mga kahon ng pizza na walang laman.

records.source: Let's visit the farm. The chickens go bock bock. The pigs go snort snort. The goats go mah mah.#The ducks go ack ack. The rabbits go sniff sniff. The cows go ooh ooh.
records.translation: Bumisita tayo sa bukid. Tok-tok ang mga manok. Singhot-singhot ang mga baboy. Mee-mee ang mga kambing.#Kwak-kwak ang mga pato. Singhot-singhot ang mga kuneho. Moo-moo ang mga baka.

records.source: This locker smells awful.
records.translation: Napakabaho ng locker na ito.

records.source: Trying to shower with your clothes on?
records.translation: Naliligo ka bang suot ang mga damit mo?

records.source: You're too weak to lift it.
records.translation: Masyado kang mahina para buhatin ito.

records.source: Alex's Locker... There's a bunch of pictures of bodybuilders taped inside the door.
records.translation: Locker ni Alex... Maraming larawan ng mga bodybuilder ang nakadikit sa loob ng pinto.

records.source: Items for women.
records.translation: Mga gamit para sa kababaihan.

records.source: It's Penny's locker. There's a frilly bathing suit inside.
records.translation: Locker ito ni Penny. May magarang kasuotang panligo sa loob.

records.source: It's Abigail's locker. It stinks pretty bad.
records.translation: Locker ito ni Abigail. Napakabaho nito.

records.source: There's a tape inside 'The Essential Blues Collection, vol. 2
records.translation: May tape sa loob na 'Ang Mahalagang Koleksiyon ng Blues, tomo 2

records.source: You rifle through Clint's personal effects. There's a stack of blacksmith aprons, some magazines, an old sword, and a nice picture of his mother.
records.translation: Hinalungkat mo ang mga personal na gamit ni Clint. May salansan ng mga epron ng panday, ilang magasin, lumang espada, at magandang larawan ng kaniyang ina.

records.source: Dear Emily,^I know you only think of me as a friend.^It's my fault. I'm too shy. I'll never have the courage to tell you the truth.^That's why I'm writing this letter to myself that I'll certainly crumple up and toss in the corner.
records.translation: Mahal kong Emily,^Alam kong kaibigan lang ang tingin mo sa akin.^Kasalanan ko. Masyado akong mahiyain. Hindi ako magkakaroon ng lakas ng loob na sabihin sa iyo ang totoo.^Kaya isinusulat ko ang liham na ito sa sarili ko, na tiyak kong kukuyumusin at itatapon sa sulok.

records.source: It's a professional-grade furnace. Peering inside, you see molten metal bubbling and churning.
records.translation: Isa itong pugon na pangpropesyonal. Sa pagsilip mo sa loob, nakita mong bumubula at umiikot ang tunaw na metal.

records.source: Clint's quality anvil. It's made from an iridium alloy.
